description: 1:100 printable massing model of a two-storey semi-detached house with rear and side extensions, its plot as two butt-jointed base tiles (patio, side path, driveway, fences, locating recesses) and the garden room (shower, office and workshop with a covered outdoor area), built from the architect's drawings.
printing_notes: Print all four parts flat side down at 0.12-0.16 mm layers. The canopy over the front door and the covered-area roof of the garden room need supports.
Glue the two site tiles edge to edge, then seat the house and garden room in their 0.6 mm recesses.
Use three perimeters so the 1.2 mm fences print solid.
Set scale_denominator identically on all four parts; 200 halves everything.
Garden-room door and window positions and the covered-area post layout are approximate.
